The metal powder of the desired weight ratio was ball milled in RETSCH PM 400 planetary ball mill using tungsten carbide vial and 10 mm diameter tungsten carbide ball (ball to powder ratio 10:1) in an inert atmosphere (argon ⩾ 99.9% purity) to avoid oxidation. To prevent the sticking of metal powder in the periphery of the vial and ball, milling was done for 5 h at the speed of 200 rpm in the presence of toluene.
After it, the alloy powder was uniaxially compressed by the manual press in a die of 15 mm diameter at 650 MPa for 30 s.
